claim.value: Uncertain approval origins may affect record paths.
claim.scope: A possible limitation; approval origin is not specified as authorship, source records or another aspect of origin.

provenance.rationale: P025 explicitly identifies uncertain approval origins as a possible influence on record paths without specifying the meaning of origin.

signal_basis.value: Trace approval records to order placement and attachment, checking whether records link to the relevant order, precede placement and demonstrate applicable authority; uncertain approval origins can limit interpretation of these paths.
signal_basis.scope: Documentary paths for the flagged orders. The observations are proposed tests, and uncertain origins are a possible limitation rather than an established finding.

provenance.rationale: The cited bundle supplies the tracing operation, observable record relationships, proposed status of observations and relevant limitation.
No unresolved empirical relation is required for this bounded possibility claim.

rationale: The operation relies on interpreting documentary connections to approval events. Uncertainty about approval origins can weaken interpretation of those connections even when the described observations occur. The claim asserts only this possible limitation, without asserting that it affected any particular order.
uncertainty: The meaning of approval origin remains unspecified, limiting specificity but not warrant for the stated possibility.
